message.content: {"reason": "Root cause: validation accuracy is plateaued at 0.7606 because the feature set encodes only absolute venue-visit frequency (so '1~3' means the same for a heavy diner and a near-non-diner) and because the fusion's free parameters (blend weight 0.6/0.4, single OOF threshold) are hand-picked rather than estimated, while one constant column (toCoupon_GEQ5min) and a non-monotone time ordinal waste splits. Historical successes confirm the exact levers that matter here: full-data retrain with CV-derived iteration counts, a CatBoost+LightGBM logit blend, and metric-aligned (accuracy) tuning with co-optimized threshold — while historical failures came from leakage and refit-on-predict wiring. So the refinement stays inside the deterministic, target-free feature engineer and the training/evaluation fusion head, leaving base learner configs, folds, seed 42, CLI, and fresh-process load semantics untouched.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: In engineer_features (and the constant maps) add four target-free affinity features — (a) affinity_ratio = matched_venue_freq/(social_index+1), (b) matched_minus_mean = matched_venue_freq - mean of the five *_freq ordinals, (c) dining_engagement = sum of Bar_freq/CoffeeHouse_freq/CarryAway_freq/RestaurantLessThan20_freq/Restaurant20To50_freq, (d) coupon_matched_x = coupon ordinal code (persisted COUPON_CODE map) times matched_venue_freq — plus two interaction categoricals coupon_matched_freq (coupon|matched_bucket or coupon|freq level) and matched_venue_x_has_children (matched_bucket|has_children); also drop toCoupon_GEQ5min from BINARY_COLS/BASE_NUM usage (verified constant=1, distinct_counts=1) and replace the TIME_MAP wall-clock values 0..4 with hour ordinals {7AM:7,10AM:10,2PM:14,6PM:18,10PM:22} while KEEPING the column name time_ord. WHY: conditional propensity ('this customer visits coffee houses more than they visit anything else') is the true acceptance mechanism and cannot be expressed by absolute levels, so trees are forced into many redundant splits; the constant column injects a dummy categorical into LightGBM and burns a CatBoost split; the scrambled time ordinal destroys the monotone time signal. HOW/Constraints: all computations are deterministic, per-row, and use only constant maps plus the already-present engineered columns, so nothing is fitted — engineer_features(df) stays identical in signature and is reused verbatim by prepare_train/prepare_predict, keeping the no-refit predict path; append the new numerics to NUM_FEATS and new categoricals to CAT_FEATS (which are also what build_cat_category_maps iterates over), NaN-safe via fillna(0) with +1 denominators and clipping affinity_ratio to [0,5]; keep FEATURES, FREQ_ORD, COUPON_VENUE, and the engineer_features(clean_features(...)) composition byte-identical otherwise.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Replace the fixed bundle ('blend_weights': (0.6,0.4)) and the single-pass threshold sweep with a joint (w, threshold) grid search on OOF probabilities — w in np.linspace(0,1,11) applied in logit space, threshold unchanged in np.linspace(0.30,0.70,81) — maximising accuracy on the original labels, and average OOF over 2 StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True) repetitions at seeds 42 and 1042 before searching; keep the full-data retrain (median CV best_iteration, CatBoost + LightGBM 1.10x iterations) and persist ('blend_weights', 'threshold', 'oof_accuracy_05', 'oof_accuracy_best'). WHY: at n=8117 the accuracy standard error is ~0.5%, so a conventional weight and a threshold tuned on one noisy OOF vector can lock in a sub-optimal operating point; averaging two fold-seed repetitions shrinks selection variance, and the joint search directly optimises the metric the supervisor computes instead of guessing a free parameter (historical success: greedy/metric-aligned fusion beat fixed simplex weights; historical failure avoided: no refit at predict, no validation labels used). HOW/Constraints: extend the CV helpers to accept a seed argument (default 42, second pass 1042) so the existing per-fold printing and best_iteration collection stay intact, and run the 2-repetition OOF pass only when _HAS_LGB (otherwise vectorise the single CatBoost OOF and force w=(1.0,0.0)); guard degenerate rows where accuracy is flat by preferring w nearest to the CV-best single-model weight rather than a coin flip; persist both weights and threshold in the joblib bundle and mirror them in model_metadata.json. Forecast: marginal gain from feature change #2, low-variance gain from this change. Keep unchanged: random_seed 42 for final retrains, StratifiedKFold(5), CATBOOST_PARAMS/LGB_PARAMS, cat_maps/feature_order bundle keys, threshold metric = plain accuracy on original label mapping, output row_id=0..N-1 and CLI contract."}}
